description: Find a Danish company's CVR number by name (or check a CVR number) in the CVR register. Use it first when you only have a name; every other tool needs the CVR number. Matches all words of the query against current company names; returns name, status, company type, industry, address and employee size band, with active, exactly named and larger companies first. Needs CVR_USER and CVR_PASSWORD in the server's environment (free system-to-system access to the CVR register); without them it returns an error saying how to get access.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

query.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. "Carlsberg" or "lego a/s". An 8-digit CVR number looks up that company.

name: search_company

companies.description: Active companies first, then exact name matches, then the largest; empty when nothing matches.

companyType.description: Legal form, e.g. APS or A/S.

employees.description: Size band from the register's latest monthly employment figures, e.g. "200-499" or "1000+".

status.description: Register status, e.g. NORMAL or OPHØRT (dissolved).

title: Search Danish companies by name
